purpose: Prevent automation and local QA activity from being treated as buyer or checkout evidence in revenue decisions.

qualifiedExternalCheckout.evaluationPriority: Payment Evidence > Qualified External Checkout > Qualified Buyer Action > Qualified Traffic > Reach

excludedSignals.reason: Regular-classified events originated from localhost QA
Regular-classified event originated from localhost QA

decisionRule: Do not amplify a route from checkout_click alone. A route may be treated as checkout evidence only after passing the qualifiedExternalCheckout filter; payment claims require independent live payment evidence.
